en:
Had to be sure we could trust you. These kind of friends are hard to come by. 

There's a malignancy growing, a sinister faction within Azeroth. Both the Horde and Alliance are unwittingly working towards their own ends. Slowing their advances and forming information networks are all we have resources for.

Take this, raise your spirits, and harken back to better days. There will be a time soon where we need our bolstered numbers for a show of force.
Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands and then report to Field Captain Korlian or Field Captain Arunnel.
Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands today and you'll earn an extra reward.
Track down and collect the spellbook materials requested by the librarian.

Your progress in the arcane arts has been exemplary, $n. I think you are ready to author a spellbook of your own.

Let's see... a quill from the Owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, and ink derived from silithid resin... yes, that will do. And for the pages, the finest Farraki Papyrus!
Bring the Mannoroc Echoing Orb to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
<Aeonas says nothing, he merely hands you the orb and turns away>
Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set.  The frame of the vest and the wildvine weave within it produces a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for potent magic to work its way through the garment.$B$BFor this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine.  This is not an easy lesson, but it is one you certainly have the skill to complete.
Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set.  The frame of the vest blends with the wildvine to produce a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for the potent magic to work its way through the garment.$B$BFor this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine.  It's a tall order, but one you should have little difficulty in filling for me.
